system_ask: Your browser asks for permission when you turn this on
system_on: Shown when the page isn't in front
system_on_always: Shown even when the page is in front
system_denied: Your browser blocks notifications from this site. Allow them in the site settings next to the address bar.
system_denied_short: Allow it in the site settings
system_unsupported: This browser doesn't support system notifications
system_always_hint: Also while a Persona tab is in front
system_footer: Shown only while the page is open but no Persona tab is in front (another site, a minimized window), once however many tabs are open. Nothing arrives once the page is closed. Click a notification to go to its conversation.
system_footer_always: Shown whenever the page is open, even while a Persona tab is in front, once however many tabs are open. Nothing arrives once the page is closed. Click a notification to go to its conversation.
sound_hint: Plays a sound when something needs you or finishes
sound_footer: Silent for the session you're viewing. When it plays follows "When something needs you" and "When an agent finishes". Applies to this browser only, and stays silent until you click or press a key on the page.
input_hint: Questions, plan approvals, tool permissions, a terminal waiting for input
input_footer: System notifications and alert sounds both follow these settings.
done_footer: A long task is a turn that ran {long} or more; quick answers are read where they were asked. You're told only if you haven't looked after a moment.
quiet_hint: Off: notifications come at any time
quiet_footer: During these hours you're not told when an agent finishes (the morning's Today card sums it up), and things that need you arrive without a sound. Reminders you asked the assistant for still come as usual. A chat bot's nudges about unanswered cards also wait while any of your devices is in its quiet hours. In this browser's time zone.
device_note: These settings belong to this browser. The hub keeps them per device, so your phone and other computers have their own.
